ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels occurring as sparse, localized anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white linear streaks on the mid-left lobe. Focal white spots (2-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the lower central region and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 130 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the fluke's visible vertical extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern. Fine-scale peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel amplitude) across the trailing boundary, interrupted by a significant irregular indentation on the distal right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters identified on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface colonization or scarring patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected multiple unaligned white linear streaks on the left lobe, including two parallel vertical marks approximately 40-60 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular geometric disruption and apparent tissue loss at the distal tip of the right lobe. Distinct linear scarring on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a highly jagged, necrotic-appearing margin compared to the more uniform serration of the left lobe tip.
